```{r Automated proteonet pipeline, include=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(ProteoNet)

folder_genesets <- ".../Gene_set_databases" #add directions for databases
df_de <- read.xlsx(".../differential_expression.xlsx")
universe <- df_de$Gene
universe <- universe[universe != ""]

my_geneset <- df_de$Gene[df_de$logFC>=1 & df_de$fdr<=0.01]
my_geneset <- na.omit(my_geneset[my_geneset != ""])
my_geneset <- unique(my_geneset)
my_geneset <- sub(";.*", "", my_geneset)

reference <- "test_analysis"
species <- 10090
min_cluster_size <- 3
score_threshold <- 0.4
selection <- "fdr"
databases_tested <- c("gocc_mouse", "gobp_mouse")
ora_min <- 3
ora_max <- 500
folder_string<- ".../String" #add directions for databases 
folder_genesets <- ".../Gene_set_databases" #add directions for databases 
folder_results <- ".../results" #add directions for results
folder_figures <- ".../figures" #add directions for figures
threshold_mean <- 0.7
threshold_min <- 0.0
min_score <- 0.4


res <- proteonet_pipeline( 
                 reference,
                 my_geneset,
                 species,
                 min_cluster_size, 
                 score_threshold, 
                 selection, 
                 databases_tested, 
                 ora_min, 
                 ora_max, 
                 folder_string, 
                 folder_genesets, 
                 folder_results, 
                 folder_figures, 
                 universe, 
                 threshold_mean, 
                 threshold_min, 
                 min_score
                 )

replot_network(res$network, folder_figures, network_height = 10, network_width = 10, label_size = 4, legend_size = 4, unlist(res$labels), reference)

```
